نتمشدق (form IIq)
# نَتَمَشْدَقُ (natamašdaqu) /na.ta.maʃ.da.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَمَشْدَقَ (tamašdaqa)
# نَتَمَشْدَقَ (natamašdaqa) /na.ta.maʃ.da.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَمَشْدَقَ (tamašdaqa)
# نَتَمَشْدَقْ (natamašdaq) /na.ta.maʃ.daq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَمَشْدَقَ (tamašdaqa)
